items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: And this fella, Charlie Crixton, who was a brother to Frank Crixton, he played with me.

ctx.x: And there was Chink Martin and, uh, uh, a fella by the name of Tots on the drums. He's dead now. And, uh, Hogan on the guitar. Well, I believe he's dead, too. I was Chink and I was about the only one living out that outfit. And this Frank Crixton played there. And this, and this fella, Charlie Crixton, who was a brother to Frank Crixton, he played with me. I think you had sure that picture before. With the Dominoes?
